summary: Iteration 6: tested Teams CRUD, mandatory team on Instalado in TagSheet, Progress team report, and Compass control. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_teams_iter6.py (9 tests, all pass). Full regression 65 pass + 1 skip. Frontend E2E: /teams admin loads, create+edit+delete team via UI works, install-records table visible, viewer role shows Acceso restringido. In TagSheet on a fresh facade panel (C1 C1 [6421217]): clicking Instalado reveals team-selector with '*' required marker; Save without team shows tag-sheet-error 'Selecciona el equipo que instaló el panel.'; selecting team option closes error, saving succeeds and API verifies team_id/team_name attached to the latest instalado history event. On /progress the progress-team-report section appears with the seeded team once it has an install, and the Equipos nav button (teams-nav-button) is present. Compass button (compass-button) opens compass-panel with N/S/E/O buttons and clicking Norte sent orientTo without page or console errors. Data cleanup executed after each UI scenario.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py teams_stats() correctly filters to FACADE_NAMES only and uses last instalado history event, but pct_total is computed over total_facade (533) while UI copy on the Progress page should clarify whether the % is over 'total fachada' vs 'total instalado' - both are exposed as pct_total and pct_instalados which is good and matches the PRD.

TagSheet.jsx preloads teamId from the object's latest instalado history event; if an admin re-saves an already-installed panel with the same team the required-team check passes silently. Consider re-prompting when the user explicitly changes status or when the previously stored team_id no longer exists in the teams list (currently no such stale guard).

Teams delete endpoint returns 200 even if the id does not exist (no 404), unlike update. Not a bug per PRD but inconsistent with update_team; consider returning 404 when matched_count==0 for symmetry.

Team.nombre has no uniqueness constraint. Creating two teams with the same name is allowed and both appear in the selector. If the PRD implies teams are identified by name/number, add a unique index or a soft duplicate check.
Compass panel closes on any orientation click and does not visually indicate the currently selected facade (no active state). Minor UX polish.
